_doc: Rounds of experiments. openai_key = whether a session of this round needs OPENAI_API_KEY (Kaggle Secrets). Each target = one run (outputs/<run>/seed_<s>/) trained once per seed, or a one-off command job. Plan sessions with: python3 scripts/kaggle_queue.py plan --round <r>

r1.goal: Baseline Paraphrase (ViT5-base) without augmentation; QUADRA preparation (5-fold difficulty, verifier).
r1.status: done 2026-10-25 (ran before the queue existed: kaggle_session.sh s1 none prep)

r2.goal: QUADRA v1: GPT fusion + verifier filter (quad F1 >= 0.8 on all quads).
r2.openai_key: yes (GPT fusion when the candidates were generated; now committed in data/aug, reruns need no key)
r2.status: done 2026-10-26 (ran before the queue existed: kaggle_session.sh s2 quadra_data quadra_gpt=...)

r3.goal: QUADRA filtering: no model verification vs target-cell verification, GPT and rules-only, 2,135 reviews each.
r3.status: done 2026-10-27 (queue sessions s1 14 jobs, s2 6 jobs)

r4.goal: QUADRA diagnosis: rules vs GPT at equal filter and size (1,192), amount sweep of the r2 set (534, 1,068 nested; 1,192 = r2), two-stage training (aug first, then gold).
r4.openai_key: no (all data committed: subsets made with src/aug/subsample.py)

r5.goal: DA baselines on the same backbone: ADA (pattern, category, joint), random concatenation and duplication controls, span-safe EDA, span substitution, GPT paraphrase, GPT quad-to-text; plus the ViT5 quad-to-text generator job (data for r6).
r5.openai_key: no on Kaggle (GPT sets llm_para / llm_q2t were generated locally and committed)
r5.status: done 2026-11-01 (s1-s4). ADA x3 and concat ran out of GPU memory (concatenated reviews, batch 16) after 1-4 min -> rerun in r6 with batch 8 x grad_accum 2

r6.goal: ADA (pattern, category, joint) and random concatenation rerun with batch 8 x grad_accum 2 (same effective batch 16 and steps; r5 attempt ran out of T4 memory), and the ViT5 quad-to-text (GenDA-style) baseline on data/aug/genda.jsonl from r5.
r6.status: done 2026-11-01 (s1-s3; the 3 jobs deferred by the s2 budget, para_ada_joint s99 and para_genda s42, s123, ran in r6+r8_s1)

r7.goal: Pilot (2 seeds, go if dev F1 >= +2 over para_none on the same seeds): (a) multi-view targets, every review trained in k element orders and decoded with a majority vote over the k views (--views 3, --views 5); (b) consensus relabelling: 3 Paraphrase teachers trained on train only label the GPT paraphrases (llm_para, which lost 3.7 F1 with copied labels) and the GPT quad-to-text set, a student is trained on train + relabelled llm_para.
r7.status: done 2026-11-01 (r7_s1, 5 jobs). Both directions below the pre-stated go rule (dev +0.72 views3, +0.40 views5, +0.61 consensus)

targets.command: python -u src/train_paraphrase.py --output_dir outputs/teacher_none --seeds 42,123,2024 --keep_ckpt && python -u src/aug/relabel.py --ckpts outputs/teacher_none/seed_42/checkpoint,outputs/teacher_none/seed_123/checkpoint,outputs/teacher_none/seed_2024/checkpoint --in data/aug/llm_para.jsonl,data/aug/llm_q2t.jsonl --out data/aug/llm_para_cons.jsonl,data/aug/llm_q2t_cons.jsonl && python -u src/train_paraphrase.py --output_dir outputs/para_llm_para_cons --seeds 42,123 --aug_path data/aug/llm_para_cons.jsonl

r8.goal: Consensus-labelled synthetic augmentation, pilot (2 seeds; go if dev F1 >= +2 over para_none on the same seeds). 20k reviews made locally by GPT infilling training reviews (opinion units hidden, ~40% of the words, filled with new content; data/aug/syn_infill.jsonl). 5 Paraphrase teachers trained on train only (seeds 11-55) label them; consensus quads (>= 3 or >= 4 of 5 votes) with spans found in the text, reviews kept only with >= 2 quads and >= 2 polarities (as in train). Student: --aug_stage pretrain (2 epochs on the synthetic set) then the gold train set. Teachers also label dev as a label-quality diagnostic (outputs/diag, never trained on).
r8.openai_key: no (synthetic texts generated locally and committed)
r8.status: done 2026-11-01 (r6+r8_s1, all jobs). No go: dev s42/s123 mean 64.35 (cons3), 63.99 (cons4) vs 65.56 required. Test not computed (protocol B)

targets.command: python src/aug/relabel.py --from_votes data/aug/syn_infill_s0.votes.jsonl,data/aug/syn_infill_s1.votes.jsonl --vote_min 3 --min_quads 2 --min_polarities 2 --out data/aug/syn_cons3.jsonl && python src/aug/relabel.py --from_votes data/aug/syn_infill_s0.votes.jsonl,data/aug/syn_infill_s1.votes.jsonl --vote_min 4 --min_quads 2 --min_polarities 2 --out data/aug/syn_cons4.jsonl

p1.goal: Protocol B pilot of label-aware infilling (src/aug/infill_labelled.py), all data from inner_train only, scored on inner_dev (--test_path; the official test is not decoded; official dev = checkpoint selection only). dv_none = no augmentation; dv_infill_u = untargeted (same category/polarity/implicit structure, new content); dv_infill_t = targeted (new aspect / opinion terms and pairs, opinion before aspect). Go rule written before results: dv_infill_t mean inner_dev F1 over 5 seeds >= dv_none + 2.0.
p1.openai_key: no (GPT data generated locally and committed)
p1.status: done 2026-11-01 (p1_s1, 15 jobs). No go: inner_dev dv_infill_t 60.72, dv_infill_u 60.31 vs dv_none 61.35 (required >= 63.35)

p2.goal: Protocol B pilot p2 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded). (a) Literature baselines not run before, paper settings, 3 seeds: DLO and ILO (Hu et al. 2022; top-3 lowest-entropy orders of the pre-trained model, lr 1e-4), MvP (Gou et al. 2023; top-5 orders by log-probability as prompted views, majority vote, lr 1e-4), Review Combination (Findings NAACL 2025; Algorithm 1, the combined set replaces train). (b) Self-training with a pseudo-label scorer (Zhang et al. ACL 2024) without external data: unlabelled texts = syn_infill texts whose source is in inner_train (data/aug/st_pool_inner.jsonl); comparison data = gold labels of inner_train vs beam candidates of 5 cross-validation models; scorer = ViT5-base, listwise + NLL; filters: confidence >= 0.7 then scorer band top 10-40 %; reranking of 4 beam candidates at inference. dv_st_conf = confidence filter only, same size (isolates the scorer filter); dv_none_rr = no augmentation + reranking (isolates reranking). Go rule written before results: dv_st reranked inner_dev F1 (5 seeds) >= dv_none + 2.0. Added after p2_s1/s2 (2026-11-02): dv_none_lr1e4 = no augmentation at lr 1e-4 (control for the lr of DLO/ILO/MvP). Re-run of the ST chain after two fixes: candidates OOM on long texts (st_pl_0/1 failed), and the comparison positive written in gold quad order while negatives were sorted (order shortcut; first scorer and dv_none_rr kept locally as outputs/*_shortcut). lr choice (written 2026-11-02, before any result at the new lrs): lr in {1e-4, 2e-4, 3e-4} with the highest mean inner_dev F1 of no augmentation over 5 seeds (dv_none_lr1e4, dv_none_lr2e4, dv_none); it fills vars.lr, and every run that waits for it is then trained at that lr (the ST chain, and ADA joint, concat, EDA, GenDA, infill_t, RC rebuilt from inner_train; DLO/ILO/MvP again only if the lr is not 1e-4; *_lrsel runs whose lr equals an existing run are dropped). Go rule (unchanged threshold, same lr on both sides): dv_st reranked mean of 5 seeds >= no augmentation at the chosen lr + 2.0.
